title: I never get to swim
content: I love swimming irl, especially in the summer. But 99.99% of my dreams that involve swimming always involve a reason I can’t. -Pool suddenly closed for the day/season/cleaning -It’s too cold -It’s too dirty -it’s too full for the size -It’s being entirely rebuilt -I did not bring a swim suit -I can’t find my husband who promised to come with me. -Never have time to go until we’re literally leaving the area. Anyone else find they’re not allowed to get to the pool?
